name: Transitland
tagline: Global GTFS/GTFS-RT aggregator with routing and stop APIs
description: Transitland aggregates GTFS and GTFS-Realtime feeds worldwide, offering REST endpoints for stops, routes, schedules, routing, and real-time vehicle data. Free tier available for real API calls with higher paid plans.

auth.details: API key via apikey query parameter or apikey header; self-serve signup. Does not use Authorization header.

pricing.free_tier_limits: REST API: 10,000 queries/month; also includes 1,000 routing queries/month and 100,000 vector tiles/month (Free plan)
pricing.paid_plans: Professional: REST 200,000 requests/month (higher paid plans increase product-specific monthly quotas; see pricing)

rate_limits: Free: REST 10,000 queries/month, routing 1,000/month, vector tiles 100,000/month; Professional REST: 200,000 requests/month; higher paid plans increase monthly quotas
use_cases: find nearby transit stops by lat/lon
look up routes and schedules for a city
